sessions.title: Sessions

sessions.empty: No open sessions. Start an agent from a task.

activate.title: Activate Truehand in {name}
activate.intro: Truehand adds to the repository the rules to move from one state to the next and two git checks. Review everything before activating.
activate.baseHint: Each task's changes are measured from here.
activate.hooksHint: commit-msg checks commit messages, pre-push blocks the push when the proofs do not hold.
activate.force: Replace the existing check with Truehand's. The old one stops working.
activate.rulesHint: Which checks each step needs. Rules are validated before saving.
activate.queued: Rules queued: confirm them on the Mac.
activate.rulesLater: The rules are created on activation with the recommended checks: right after, you review and edit them here.
activate.commitHint: Rules and approvers count for tasks (and CI) only once they are on the base branch. Check what changes: exactly this text is committed, nothing else.
activate.approvers: Who will be able to approve
activate.noApprovers: No approvers: approvals stay with this Mac's Touch ID, unsigned.
activate.noChanges: No text differences against the base branch.
activate.pushBase: Committed locally: push {base}, tasks start from the remote branch.
activate.saveFirst: Save your edits first: only the saved text shown here is committed.
activate.queuedStale: The file changed after the request: confirming would be refused. Cancel it and ask again.
activate.pushTitle: The rules are not on {base} yet
activate.pushHint: The rules are committed on the local branch: they count for tasks and CI only once they reach the remote. Below is what the push will bring.
activate.removedResign: A removed key stops counting as soon as the rules reach the base, in CI too: approvals signed with it must be signed again.

remote.offHint: Truehand answers only on this Mac.
remote.tailnetHint: Truehand also listens on the tailnet address: only your Tailscale devices, never the internet.
remote.tailscale-serveHint: Published by Tailscale with HTTPS on your tailnet.
remote.headlessHint: Server without a screen: reach it from the tailnet through tailscale serve (https). Confirm actions with an owner passkey.

settings.title: Settings
settings.permissionHint: How every new session starts. Never without permissions.
settings.macOnly: Can be changed only from the Mac.
settings.removeHint: Removing a project only removes it from Truehand: the files stay where they are.
settings.claudeMissing: Not found. Install Claude Code and reopen Truehand.
settings.ghLogin: Installed but not connected: run gh auth login
settings.ghMissing: Not found: needed to open PRs
settings.globalPlugin: The Truehand plugin is also installed in Claude Code: sessions opened outside this app use that copy.
settings.rotateHint: The Mac app gets a new token; paired phones stay paired.
settings.sessionsUnavailable: Agents cannot start: Truehand runs read-only or inside an agent session.

pair.title: Pair a phone
pair.intro: The phone sees the board, follows the agents and answers them. Approvals and pushes are still confirmed here on the Mac.
pair.step1: On the phone, connected to the tailnet, open
pair.step2: Scan the QR or type the code.
pair.qrAlt: QR code to pair the phone
pair.security: The code works once, for 2 minutes. The phone gets its own access, which you can revoke from the settings.
pair.phoneIntro: Enter the code shown on the Mac, in Settings → Pair a phone.
pair.invalid: Invalid or expired code: generate a new one on the Mac.
pair.tooMany: Too many tries: wait a minute and make a new code.
pair.tokenTitle: On the Mac in a browser?
pair.tokenHint: Paste the Truehand app token (in the app menu). This page does not keep it.

newTask.title: New task
newTask.name: Title
newTask.namePlaceholder: What needs doing, in a few words
newTask.descriptionPlaceholder: Context, expected behaviour, useful links. Markdown supported.
newTask.ticketHint: If set, the agent reads the ticket to prepare the plan.
newTask.ticketError: Task created, but the ticket could not be read: {error}
newTask.worktreeHint: So several agents can work in parallel without stepping on each other.
newTask.scopeHint: One per line, e.g. lib/auth/**. Empty = all

addProject.title: Add project
addProject.pathHint: A git folder in your home.
addProject.name: Project name
addProject.namePlaceholder: Optional: defaults to the folder name
addProject.pathHintRemote: A git folder in that machine's home.

machine.title: Machines
machine.hint: Projects on other computers reached over ssh (tailnet too). Agents run there, you follow them from here.
machine.sshHint: As you type it with ssh: a name in ~/.ssh/config or a tailnet address.
machine.label: Name
machine.offlineHint: The machine does not answer: tasks stay visible but agents cannot start.

sendBack.tellAgent: Tell the agent in its terminal
sendBack.agentNote: The task went back to “{state}”: read the last comment.

invisible.warning: Invisible characters in the text: {n}. Approving approves them too.

err.already-merged: The task is already merged into the base branch: nothing to push.
err.no-remote: The repository has no “origin” remote: add one to push.
err.remote-not-github: “origin” is a local folder: a pull request needs a GitHub remote.
err.gh-missing: gh (GitHub CLI) is missing on this Mac: install it and run “gh auth login”.
err.gh-auth: gh can't reach GitHub: run “gh auth login” on the Mac and try again.
err.config-not-committed: The rules (.truehand/config.yaml) are not committed on the base branch: task folders start from there. Commit them first.
err.config-not-pushed: The rules are committed locally but not on the remote: push the base branch, tasks start from there.
err.no-approvers: The base branch config lists no approvers: add this Mac's key and commit the rules.
err.config-changed: The config changed since you read it: reloaded. Read it again and retry.
err.config-invalid: The rules are not acceptable: they do not load, or they remove every approver. Fix .truehand/config.yaml and try again (the reason is in the technical details).
err.not-on-base: Check out {base} first: the rules are committed there.
err.other-changes-staged: Other changes are staged: commit or unstage them first.
err.remote-unavailable: Saved, but access from other devices did not start: {error}
err.signedRefused: The server refused the signature: expired, already used, or no longer matching what you see. Try again.
err.passkeyRefused: The server refused the passkey: it is not (or no longer) an owner, or the request changed. Try again.
err.base-moved: The base changed after the preview: reload and check again what is pushed.
err.not-only-config: Some commits are not just changes to .truehand/config.yaml (other files or a merge): from here only the configuration is pushed. The reason is in the technical details.
err.base-diverged: The local and remote base branches have diverged: fix them with git before pushing.
err.base-unknown: This state of the base is not on the remote: use “Update from remote” on the board and try again; if it persists, check the base name in the rules.
err.nothing-to-push: Nothing to push: the remote already has these rules.
err.base-not-remote: The base is not a remote branch (origin/…): from here only the remote is pushed to.
err.signature-refused: The server refused the signature: expired, already used, or no longer matching what you see. Try again.
err.base-behind: The remote moved ahead: use “Update from remote” on the project's board and try again.
err.push-base-refused: Push refused: the base's history is not what was expected (for example it was rewritten). Check it with git; the reason is in the technical details.
err.restack-moved: The point changed after the preview: reload and check again.
err.plan-changed: The plan changed while you were reading it: open it again and reread it before approving.
err.plan-incomplete: The plan is incomplete: some sections are missing. Send it back to the agent.
err.scope-moved: The list of files changed after the preview: reload and check again.
err.nothing-outside: No files are outside the scope any more: nothing to widen.
err.scope-refused: The scope was not widened: there is nothing new to add.
err.scope-unavailable: The task's scope cannot be worked out right now (for example the chain of tasks below it is broken).
err.plan-missing: The task has no plan to approve yet.
err.not-planned: The task is no longer waiting for its plan to be approved.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.intro: A passkey is your fingerprint or face on the phone (or a security key): with it you approve plans, pushes and PRs from any device, even where there is no Mac. Any system works: Android, iPhone, Mac, Windows, FIDO2 keys.
passkey.codeTitle: Add a passkey from another device
passkey.codeHint: Scan the QR with the phone, or open the address and type the code. It works once and for a few minutes.
passkey.serverOld: This server does not handle passkeys yet: update Truehand.
passkey.needsHttps: Passkeys need HTTPS: turn on access through tailscale serve (above, “Phone access”) and open Truehand from its https://….ts.net address.
passkey.unsupported: This browser does not handle passkeys: use an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
passkey.otherHost: This server's passkeys are for {host}: open it from there to add one or sign.

renamed.one: The machine's name changed ({old} → {host}): 1 passkey registered under the old name no longer works here. Register it again and update the projects' approvers.
renamed.other: The machine's name changed ({old} → {host}): {n} passkeys registered under the old name no longer work here. Register them again and update the projects' approvers.

passkey.syncedHint: Copied to your Google or iCloud account: it works on all your devices, and is as safe as that account.
passkey.syncedRisk: Synced passkeys live in your Google or iCloud account: whoever gets into that account can sign as you. Protect it with two-step verification.
passkey.revoked: Passkey {label} revoked. If it approves for a project, remove it from that project's rules too: it counts there while it is listed.
passkey.label: Passkey name
passkey.labelHint: So you can tell it apart, for example “Galaxy S25” or “work iPhone”.
passkey.readyHint: Now tap “Create the passkey”: the device asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN.
passkey.actionHint: You sign here with your passkey: it shows what you are approving and asks for your fingerprint or face.
passkey.ownerRequired: This needs the server owner's signature with a passkey.
passkey.signHint: This is exactly what you sign, read from the bytes that go to the authenticator.

actionName.commit-config: Commit the rules on the base
actionName.push-base: Push the rules to the remote

err.timeout: Timed out: try again and confirm on the device.
err.unsupported: This browser does not handle passkeys.
err.insecure: Passkeys need HTTPS: open Truehand from its tailscale serve address.
err.exists: This device already has a passkey for this server.
err.wrong-host: The passkey is for another address ({detail}): open Truehand from there.
err.bad-message: The server asked to sign an invalid message: not signed.
err.mismatch: The message to sign does not match what you see ({detail}): not signed.
err.no-owner: No owner passkey on this server: register one with “sudo truehand passkey bootstrap” on the server.
err.elsewhere: The owner passkey is on {detail}: approve from there, or add this device (Settings → Passkeys).
err.no-preview: The preview of what would be pushed is missing: not signing. Update Truehand on the server.

approver.title: Approver of a project
approver.titleFor: Make {label} an approver of a project
approver.offer: Use it to approve a project's tasks? It becomes an approver in the project's rules.
approver.hint: The passkey's public key goes into the project's .truehand/config.yaml. It counts only once committed on the base and pushed to the remote, where CI checks it.
approver.step1: adds the passkey to the approvers in the rules
approver.step2: you commit the rules on the base (signing)
approver.step3: you push them to the remote (signing)
approver.already: This passkey is already one of the project's approvers.
approver.added: Added to the rules: now commit them on the base.

choose.approver: Which approver are you signing as?
choose.approverHint: The project has several approvers: pick the one whose passkey is on this device.
choose.owner: Which passkey are you signing with?
choose.ownerHint: The server has several owner passkeys: pick the one on this device.

passkey.subjectVerified: Fingerprint checked here: it matches this very request.

request.enrollCode: Make a code for a passkey
request.commitConfig: Commit the rules on the base
request.pushBase: Push the rules to the remote
request.activate: Turn Truehand on in a project

ownerTitle.add-owner: Make {label} an owner of the server

revokedOrphans.one: Passkey {label} revoked: 1 owner it had confirmed must be confirmed again.
revokedOrphans.other: Passkey {label} revoked: {n} owners it had confirmed must be confirmed again.

passkey.granted: {label} is now an owner of the server.
passkey.noOwner: This server has no owner yet: on the server run
passkey.codeOwner: Also an owner of the server
passkey.codeOwnerHint: An owner confirms the server's actions with the passkey (pairing devices, settings, revoking). Another owner or the Mac must confirm it.

pending.mac: To confirm with Touch ID in the Mac app.
pending.owner: To confirm with another owner's passkey: Settings → Passkeys → “Confirm owner”.
pending.anchor: The server is confirming it: “truehand passkey bootstrap” recognises it and closes by itself within seconds.
pending.expired: Expired: the server restarted before it was confirmed. Register this device again.

passkey.dependsOn: Your passkey was confirmed through this one: revoke it from another owner's passkey.
passkey.revokeSelf: You cannot revoke the passkey you are signing with: do it from another owner's passkey.
passkey.keyCompare: It must be identical to the fingerprint the registering device shows: if it differs, cancel.
passkey.elsewhereHint: The chosen passkey ({label}) was not registered from this browser: unless it is synced here, the device will not find it.
passkey.expiredHere: Expired: the server restarted before it was confirmed. Register this device again.
passkey.expiredElsewhere: Expired: the server restarted before it was confirmed. It must be registered again from its own device; here you can only remove it.
passkey.softHint: Revoked from here: it holds until someone restores the file on the server. To make it final, run on the server:
passkey.softHintMac: Revoked from a browser: it holds until someone restores the file on the server. Make it final with Touch ID.
passkey.revocationsError: Revocation list unreadable: until it is fixed no passkey counts as owner.

push.otherFiles: Warning: these commits touch files other than .truehand/config.yaml. Sign only if you expect it.

passkey.revocationsMac: Open the Truehand app on the Mac: without its revocation list no passkey counts as owner.
passkey.revocationsInvalid: The server's revocation list is invalid: no passkey counts as owner until it is fixed. On the server run “sudo truehand passkey revoke --repair”, which keeps the durable revocations. If the file is a link, check where it points and copy the real list there.
passkey.suspendedHint: Suspended until the revocation list is fixed (see above).
passkey.problemShort: It does not count as owner for now.

enroll.title: Sign in with a passkey
enroll.intro: For a server without a screen (Linux) or a new device: a one-time code pairs this browser and registers its passkey, which signs approvals from then on.
enroll.step2: or make the code on a device already set up (Settings → Passkeys)
enroll.step3: type the code here and confirm with fingerprint, face or PIN
enroll.done: Passkey {label} registered: this device is paired.
enroll.toPair: I have a regular pairing code
enroll.fromPair: Server without a screen? Sign in with a passkey
enroll.owner: It is also an owner of the server: from here you confirm pairings, settings and revocations.
enroll.keyHint: Whoever confirms this passkey as an owner sees the same fingerprint: check that they match.
enroll.keyMismatch: Warning: this device created key {mine}, but the server stored {server}. Do not confirm it and tell whoever runs the server.
enroll.keyFromServer: Fingerprint from the server (not checked by this device)
enroll.keyFromServerHint: This browser does not expose the new key: the fingerprint comes from the server. Compare it with what the confirming owner sees.

restack.title: Built on top of {on}
restack.body: This task is built on top of {on}, which is not in main yet. Move the base on top of {on} to test only this task's changes.
restack.skipped: Commits that move to that task ({n})

ignore.one: The folder has 1 file that is not part of {on}'s commits ({examples}): moving the base confirms it is not {on}'s and it will be ignored.
ignore.other: The folder has {n} files that are not part of {on}'s commits (e.g. {examples}): moving the base confirms they are not {on}'s and they will be ignored.

stack.on: Stacked on {on}: its changes are measured from the point where {on} ends.
stack.closed: Other tasks are stacked on this one ({by}): it is judged up to commit {tip} and agents no longer work on it. Delivering, pushing and the PR remain.
stack.broken: The chain of tasks below this one no longer holds: no checks or proofs until the base is moved, and the server proposes no point right now.
stack.brokenFix: The chain of tasks below this one no longer holds: no checks or proofs until you move the base (below).

inbox.unreachable: The server is not answering: what you see may be out of date.
inbox.noPasskey: To approve from this phone, register a passkey.
inbox.noProjects: No projects yet. Add one to start.
inbox.agentsWorking: The agents are working: nothing to decide for now.
inbox.allQuiet: Nothing to do and no agent working.

kind.question: The agent asks you
kind.restack: To move on top of another task

decision.readFirst: Open the full plan to approve.

whole.one: You approve the whole plan (1 section), not only the summary.
whole.other: You approve the whole plan ({n} sections), not only the summary.

decision.alsoAsks: The agent also asked you a question: approving the plan does not answer it.

scope.body: The agent changed files the task did not plan for. If they are fine, widen the scope; otherwise send the task back to the agent.
scope.special: name with special characters: only this file is added

agents.theirsHint: Failing checks or stale proofs: the agent fixes them, no decision needed from you.
